input.quote: 14.2 Upon creation and subject to payment of the applicable Fees, Customer owns each Deliverable created specifically for Customer. Vendor hereby assigns to Customer all worldwide right, title, and interest in those Deliverables and shall obtain equivalent assignments from its personnel.
input.rationale: The IP scheme meets the preferred position in full. § 14.1 confirms Customer owns Customer Data, Customer Confidential Information and its independent IP, with no transfer to Vendor beyond a processing right limited to delivering the Services (reinforced by § 15.1's no-sale/no-model-training restrictions). § 14.2 gives Customer ownership of each Deliverable with a present assignment from Vendor plus personnel assignments and further-assurance. § 14.3 lets Vendor retain only Vendor Technology and channels any embedded Vendor Technology into the § 13.2 licence, which is perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free and fully paid, extends to Affiliates and contractors, and includes modification and derivative works. § 14.4 negates joint ownership absent a signed instrument and keeps feedback voluntary with Customer retaining unrestricted use. No assignment of Customer IP or data to Vendor and no joint-ownership trap, so no redline is warranted.
